subject: Founder perks: voucher consolidation + SLA implications
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily@launchhub.org>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Founder perk vouchers — consolidation question

Hi Naomi,

Quick question from LaunchHub: we run three parallel cohorts and several founders have overlapping "founder perk" vouchers (small promotional credits) that were issued per-person during sign-ups. We want to consolidate those vouchers into a single cohort-level pool so teams can draw credits on behalf of the company during demo weeks. Will that be possible under Redwood's promo rules, and will a consolidated pool change our SLA/discount treatment for the cohort (we're on a pilot discount today)?

Attached: LaunchHub_SOW.pdf (pdf) — draft SOW for the cohort.

If there's a short ops flow or legal flag we should be aware of, please let me know. We need to confirm before we finalize the SOW.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Carter
Partnerships Lead, LaunchHub Accelerator

From: naomi.feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Founder perk vouchers — consolidation question

Hi Emily — thanks for the SOW and the question. Short answer: we can usually consolidate per-founder promo credits into a cohort pool, but there are two operational and contracting implications you should know about:

1) Pricing & discounting: moving to a cohort-level pool often changes how we recognize committed usage and therefore can affect eligibility for certain pilot discounts (your current pilot discount was granted at per-founder scale).

2) SLA & support scope: if the cohort pool is used as a shared company account that expects predictable throughput, that can push the engagement into a different support tier. That has implications for uptime/latency guarantees and for reservation of capacity during demo windows.

Can you share an estimate of monthly token/embedding consumption across the cohort (ballpark is fine)? That will help us size the ask and propose whether the cohort should remain under the pilot discount or move to a dedicated cohort package.

Ben — looping you in to propose a pricing pathway and a way to operationalize the pool (billing mapping + account IDs). Marissa — can you flag any current promo controls that block consolidation?

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Thanks Naomi / Emily — read the SOW. Emily, the path that minimizes friction: consolidate into a single LaunchHub cohort pool under one billing entity, keep the pilot discount for an interim period (90 days) to avoid breaking demo plans, and then evaluate committed pricing if consumption exceeds X tokens/month.

Proposed commercial terms (high level):
- 90-day transition: cohort pool honored at current pilot discount.
- Post-transition: tiered committed rates if monthly usage > 5M tokens (we would propose a 12-month committed credit addendum).
- SLA: for the transition period we'll keep current support SLA; if you want reserved capacity for demo windows we can offer a limited dedicated cushion (one-time fee + modest uplift to discount).

Ops ask: we need cohort owner billing email, the list of founder-winner accounts to transfer, and confirmation of the expected peak demo windows (dates/timezones).

I'm attaching a draft pricing sheet for internal review: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (xlsx).

Naomi / Marissa — is the 90-day concession okay from finance/legal? If so I'll draft the amendment for Emily to sign.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founder perk vouchers — consolidation question

Ben / Naomi — finance review here. We can approve a 90-day interim carry of the existing pilot discount while the cohort consolidates, subject to these constraints:

- Contracting: must sign a short addendum (we'll use a templated "promo consolidation" addendum) that specifies the cohort owner and that usage beyond the 90-day window will be subject to a committed-rate evaluation.
- Accounting: the consolidated pool will be invoiced to a single billing entity; we require an accounting contact for LaunchHub and a PO or billing alias to map credits correctly.
- Tax & voucher treatment: moving vouchers from individuals to a company pool can create different tax treatments for some cohorts outside the US — Emily, if you have international founders, flag legal so we can include tax language.

We cannot commit to reserved capacity under the interim concession. If LaunchHub requires guaranteed capacity during demo windows, that needs a separate dedicated reservation line (one-time reservation fee + monthly uplift) and explicit SLA terms.

If you confirm the billing entity and peak dates, we can prepare the addendum (legal will need 3 business days for review).

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Founder perk vouchers — consolidation question

Hi Naomi / Ben / Laura — this is helpful, thanks.

We can consolidate to one billing entity: accounting@launchhub.org. Expected baseline for the cohort: ~800k tokens/month across demo/non-demo weeks; peak demo week could push to ~1.6M tokens for a 3–4 day window. Most founders are US-based but we have a small APAC cohort — I'll loop Legal to confirm tax notes.

We accept the 90-day interim concession and the addendum approach. Two quick follow-ups before we sign:
1) Can the addendum include a simple clause that preserves the current pilot-level rate for any usage under 1M tokens/month even after the transition if cohort consumption remains flat for two consecutive months?
2) For the demo-week reserved cushion, can you provide a ballpark one-time reservation fee and monthly uplift (so we can budget and propose in our SOW)?

If you can send the addendum and a ballpark reservation cost, we'll route to legal and aim to sign next week.

Best,
Emily
